data.one_liner: An extension of the Flutter PaginatedDataTable supporting server-side pagination and async loading.
data.what_it_does: Advanced Datatable extends Flutter's PaginatedDataTable to support asynchronous row loading, allowing you to connect tables to large data sources and load only the current page. It also supports custom loading and error widgets, hiding empty rows, server-side filtering, and customizable footers.
use_when: You need a paginated data table that loads data asynchronously from a server or large database.
You require server-side filtering and sorting for your table data.
You want to customize the table footer or hide empty rows.
avoid_when: You already have all data locally in memory and the standard PaginatedDataTable is sufficient.
You need complex charts or non-tabular data displays.
strengths: Supports async row loading for large data sets
Provides hooks for server-side filtering and sorting
Allows custom footers, loading widgets, and error widgets
weaknesses: Requires implementing custom data sources extending AdvancedDataTableSource
Limited documentation outside of the README examples
data.minimal_example:
AdvancedPaginatedDataTable(
  addEmptyRows: false,
  source: source,
  showFirstLastButtons: true,
  rowsPerPage: rowsPerPage,
  availableRowsPerPage: [1, 5, 10, 50],
  onRowsPerPageChanged: (newRowsPerPage) {},
  columns: [
    DataColumn(label: Text('Row no')),
    DataColumn(label: Text('Value'))
  ],
)
